title.narrative: Reinforcing the National TB Response in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mozambique, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: Reduce the incidence of TB (per 100,000 population) from 361 in 2022 to 310 in 2026. Reduce TB-related Mortality (per 100,000 population) from 43 in 2022 to 35 in 2026. The objectives of this program are: Identify 90% of incident TB cases and offer appropriate treatment to all them. Identfy 90% of incident TB cases in vulnerable population, offer appropriate treatment to all of them to successfully treat 90% of them. Increase the coverage of the laboratory diagnostic network with particular attention to rapid tests. Identify all incident cases of resistant tuberculosis offer appropriate treatment. Successfully treat 90% or more of all drug-sensitive tuberculosis patients regardless of their HIV status

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for MOZ-T-MOHP04
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- private/non-governmental facilities; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Number of people with pre-XDR/XDR TB enrolled on treatment
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
